serviceDescription:
Audits a public website's product positioning, messaging and conversion copy, returning a Reveal Index score (0-100), a Blindspot Map of findings, a prioritised Blueprint and an Action Queue.
url(string, required): absolute public http(s) URL to audit; timeoutSeconds(number, optional): max seconds to wait, default 180, max 300; format(string, optional): export format, markdown or json
MCP tool revel_analyze_website (via tools/call); poll revel_get_analysis until status is completed or partial
curl -X POST https://tryrevel.xyz/api/mcp -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"revel_analyze_website","arguments":{"url":"https://example.com"}}}'
